Yugal Chandra Pande ………Petitioner
 Versus
Vice Chancellor ……….Respondent
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. S.K. Mandal, learned counsel for the 
petitioner. 
2. Mr. Vivek Kumar, learned counsel, holding
the brief of Mr. C.S. Rawat, learned counsel for the 
respondents. 
3. Ms. Geetanjali Dhami, learned counsel for the 
intervener. 
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits 
that petitioner is already retired from service 
therefore for future promotion in the respondent 
Department, he has no objection. 
5. Ms. Geetanjali Dhami, learned counsel for the 
interveners submits that due to pendency of this 
petition, all the promotions are put on hold. 
6. This Court failed to understand why the
promotional exercise has been put on hold when
the petitioner is already retired from service. 
7. How this Court clarifying interim order 
dated 11.03.2026 will not come into the way of the 
Department for initiating promotional exercise and 
the Department is free to proceed with the same. 
8. By the interim order dated 11.03.2026 the 
impugned order was stayed and now, the 
petitioner is already retired on 31.08.2026, 
however, his pensionary benefits have been put on 
hold. 
9. List on 03.11.2026.
10. On the next date, learned counsel for the  respondents is directed to get instructions why the 
pensionary benefits of the petitioner have been put 
on hold. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 16.10.2026
SKS
